constraints: sheet is 0-based; if omitted or -1 is passed, the command applies to the current sheet.
Returns null if tableName is not found or if column is higher than the number of columns in the table.
The returned object's dataField property is omitted if the table is displayed automatically (not bound to a data context).

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Returns an object describing the current attributes (dataField, name, footerText, footerFormula, filterButtonVisible) of the specified column of tableName.

sentinelValues.meaning: Same as omitting the parameter: applies to the current sheet.
